'''2017 US Nationals Day 2 Greg Shaw LS Combat Preparedness (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Greg Shaw]] at [[2017 U.S. National Championship]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Combat Preparedness (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/resources/tournament-decklists/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013125443/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/tournament-decklists.html Internet Archive]
